name: Default
shortDescription: SonarQube Community Build for continuous code quality and security inspection, with a PostgreSQL database and persistent plugins and search indexes.

alerts.message: SonarQube needs at least 4 GB of RAM to start. The embedded Elasticsearch runs with mmap disabled, so no vm.max_map_count change on the host is required.
Log in with the default credentials admin / admin right after the first start; SonarQube then asks you to set a new administrator password.
